teaser: Four trail maps are folded in the glove compartment, and none of them has been read past the parking lot sign. Life path 4 built you for the long haul — foundations, schedules, the thing finished and load-bearing. ENFP built you for the open trail itself, for what's past the ridge and who else might come along. The crossing here is a builder who keeps sketching a new route before the last one is finished, then circles back to finish it anyway, because the 4 in you does not let a structure sit half-built for long, no matter how many ridges called first.
